Aegis.purpose: Personal Adaptive AI Operating System — a 7-layer adaptive AI OS for ambient environment orchestration, general-purpose intelligence, second brain, and secure autonomy. This is the user's primary AI project and the architectural inspiration for TEMPORARY AEGIS.

architecture.overview: 7-layer architecture with strict downward dependencies. L1 (Core Runtime) → L2 (Foundation) → L3 (AI Kernel) → L4 (Memory/Knowledge) → L5 (Execution) → L6 (Planning) → L7 (HCI, not started). Plus redesign packages: reasoning, prompts, capabilities.

key_features: Structured output processor with Pydantic validation
PII/secret scrubber with auto P0 elevation
6 provider adapters: fake, ollama, openrouter, groq, vllm

integration_notes.TEMPORARY_AEGIS_RELATIONSHIP: Aegis is the architectural blueprint for TEMPORARY AEGIS. Its concepts (layered architecture, memory tiers, execution pipeline, routing, security model) inform how the live system is configured. AEGIS L4 memory concepts map to TEMPORARY AEGIS memory schema. AEGIS L3 routing concepts map to model routing.
integration_notes.code_reuse: Aegis code is not directly reused — TEMPORARY AEGIS uses existing tools (Hermes, Codex, 9Router) rather than importing Aegis. However, Aegis documentation and architectural decisions inform configuration.
integration_notes.testing_insights: Aegis test suite (1060 tests) provides validation patterns. The STAB-01 fix (test suite hang) is a relevant lesson for TEMPORARY AEGIS testing.
